entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought recently.

I can certainly help you with that. To start, could you please provide your order number? And just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
My order number is VF90210. It's definitely a preference issue. I've taken them on one short ride, and they're just not working for me. I'm getting some pretty bad blisters on my heels.

I see. I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me pull up your order... VF90210... Okay, I see you received them 7 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return policy for apparel and shoes.
That's great. So I can get a full refund?
Absolutely. As long as the cycling shoes are in like-new condition, we can process a full refund to your original payment method once we receive them. Have any cleats been installed on them yet?
No, I didn't get that far. I wanted to test the fit on the bike before I attached the cleats. So they're basically brand new, aside from that one test ride.

Perfect. I've just initiated the return process in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions in the next few minutes. Just pack them in the original box and drop them off.

Okay, thank you. I appreciate how easy that was. Now, since I'm a VIP member and will need to order a different pair, is there anything you can do for me? Perhaps a small discount code for my next purchase to offset the inconvenience of having to repackage and ship these back?

That's a reasonable request. While our policy doesn't allow credits for fit issues, I do see your VIP status and value your business. I can definitely offer you complimentary expedited shipping on your next order, and I'll add a 15% off coupon to your account that you can use on any non-sale item. How does that sound?
That sounds fantastic. Expedited shipping and a coupon is more than fair. I really appreciate you doing that, David.
Of course. Happy to help. I've just applied those perks to your account. You'll see them at checkout. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've solved my problem and then some. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
